name: capture
description: Self-hosted session recording and replay built on rrweb

scripts.build: esbuild src/recorder/index.js --bundle --minify --outfile=public/recorder.bundle.js && esbuild src/replay/index.js --bundle --minify --outfile=public/replay.bundle.js && esbuild src/snippet.js --minify --outfile=public/capture.js && esbuild src/analyze/replayer-entry.js --bundle --minify --outfile=src/analyze/replayer.bundle.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/client/*.test.mjs && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests/server
